title: Laparoscopic Guided Transversus Abdominis Plane Block for Postoperative Analgesia After Pediatric Laparoscopic Surgery.
brief_summary: The aim of this study will be to investigate the safety and analgesic efficacy of Transversus Abdominis Plane (TAB) Block versus psoas block blockade. Both blocks will be administered surgically and guided by the laparoscopy screen in children undergoing laparoscopic surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children (1-6 years) of both sexes undergoing elective laparoscopic surgeries that last \>30minutes (eg. undescended testis and inguinal hernia repair).
* Written consent, free and informed

Exclusion Criteria:

* Significant respiratory, cardiac or renal disease
* BMI \>95th percentile for age.
